name: TRUMPET
source: Three years have passed since Shinima Junjou committed suicide. During this time, he has been wandering around without a purpose, unable to fully cross over to the other side. But, a chance encounter changed Junjou's entire opinion of his situation. What was once "a second at life" quickly became a quest to find the reason behind his inability to disappear.
translation: 岛纯城自杀已经过去三年了。这段时间他一直在漫无目的的徘徊，无法完全穿越到彼岸。但是，一次偶然的邂逅改变了纯城对自己处境的看法。曾经的“生命中的一秒钟”很快就变成了寻找他无法消失背后原因的探索。
